pages.title: Cuphead King Dice in His Classic Tuxedo with a Bow Tie, Gloves, and a Sly Grin Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead's King Dice in his classic tuxedo, adjusting his bow tie and extending a gloved hand beneath theater drapes. His curled mustache, dice spots, waistcoat buttons, and long coat tails add smaller sections to the coloring sheet, while his trousers and the stage curtains provide larger spaces.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Watching Cuphead and Mugman Play at the Devil's Casino Dice Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice watching Cuphead and Mugman at the Devil's casino dice table, with tumbling dice and stacks of chips. Cuphead reaches toward the table as Mugman grips its edge with a worried expression. The coloring sheet includes card suit decorations, a tied curtain, and clearly outlined faces and gloves.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Reporting Cuphead and Mugman's Progress to the Devil Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice reporting Cuphead and Mugman's progress to the Devil, holding an unfurled scroll beside the Devil's pointed throne. Framed portraits of the brothers hang above them, and the Devil rests his chin on one hand while holding his trident. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing shapes with fur, dice spots, and decorative frames.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Blocking the Passage Through the Die House as Cuphead and Mugman Approach Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice blocking the Die House passage as Cuphead and Mugman approach, standing with both gloved hands on his hips. The brothers face him across a tiled floor, framed by open double doors with round windows. Dice motifs, tied curtains, and rope barriers add smaller details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Checking Mugman's Soul Contracts Beside the Die House Chalkboard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice checking Mugman's soul contracts beside the Die House chalkboard, with several rolled papers gathered in his gloves. Mugman gestures upward near the board's circles and crossed marks. The coloring sheet includes a round window, a tied curtain, paneled walls, and spacious areas across King Dice's long tuxedo.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Crossing Completed Numbers Off the Die House Chalkboard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice crossing completed numbers off the Die House chalkboard, holding chalk beside panels marked with groups of dice spots. He stands before a large round window with one hand tucked behind his back. The coloring sheet offers broad tuxedo sections alongside smaller pips, chalk marks, and tiled floor shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Singing in the Die House Beside Its Round Windows and Theater Curtains Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice singing inside the Die House, with one glove against his chest and the other extended between round windows. His open mouth, curled mustache, and oversized bow tie stand out against the theater curtains. Larger clothing areas contrast with the narrow curtain folds and diamond wall panels on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Clapping to Summon the Floating Die Above His Numbered Casino Game Board Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice clapping to summon a floating die above his numbered casino game board, framed by curtains on either side. The curved table displays spaces numbered one through nine beneath his joined gloves. His bow tie, dice spots, table trim, and decorative legs provide varied shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Assembling Chips Bettigan From a Stack of Poker Chips Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice assembling Chips Bettigan from poker chips, holding a single chip above the smiling character's tall stacked body. Chips Bettigan wears a cowboy hat and raises both gloved fists beside the casino counter. The coloring sheet pairs repeated chip sections with King Dice's broad coat panels and trousers.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Laughing as Cuphead Lands on the Start Over Space of His Casino Game Board Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice laughing as Cuphead lands on the Start Over space, with a looping arrow and dice marking the spot. Cuphead spreads his gloves and looks upward while King Dice leans over the winding game board. The coloring sheet includes large curved track spaces, expressive faces, and draped curtains.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Using His Walking Gloved Hand to Send Marching Playing Cards Across the Casino Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice using his walking gloved hand to send marching playing cards across a casino table decorated with outlined shapes. Three smiling cards display spade, heart, and club symbols beneath his towering figure. Chip stacks, columns, hanging lights, and curtains add smaller background sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Battling Cuphead and Mugman as They Parry the Heart Cards in His Card Parade Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice battling Cuphead and Mugman as they parry heart cards, with both brothers jumping above the marching card parade. King Dice spreads his gloves behind them while large heart symbols and impact bursts fill the foreground. The coloring sheet combines lively character poses with chip stacks, columns, and layered casino table borders.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Defeated Behind the Casino Table with a Chipped Dice Head and a Damaged Tuxedo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a defeated King Dice behind the casino table, with a chipped dice head, torn tuxedo sleeves, and drooping eyes. Small fragments rest between his gloves, and stars circle above his head. The coloring sheet leaves large open areas in his face and clothing, with narrower details along the torn edges and stage curtains.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Singing Into His Microphone on the Roll the Dice Game Show Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice singing into a round microphone on the Roll the Dice game show stage, extending one hand toward the audience. His wide stance, long coat tails, bow tie, and smiling dice face fill most of the coloring sheet. Curtain folds, a microphone stand, and the stage's circular trim add distinct surrounding shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Selecting Telephone from the Audience Beneath the Game Show Spotlight Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice selecting Telephone from the game show audience, pointing toward the seated contestant beneath a spotlight beside the stage. Telephone's receiver, rotary dial, curled cord, and gloved hands provide distinctive details among the rows of seats. Broad audience silhouettes and stage curtains surround the smaller outlined features on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Showing Telephone the Door to the Mystery Prize Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice presenting the mystery prize room door to Telephone, who stands beside its large question mark and star decorations. King Dice gestures with an open palm while Telephone reaches toward the door. The coloring sheet includes a rotary dial, curled cord, ornate frame, keyholes, and small sparkles against broad hallway walls.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Having His Dice Head Polished in Front of His Dressing Room Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice having his dice head polished before his dressing room mirror, seated on a stool while an attendant holds a cloth. Round bulbs frame the mirror, which shows the back of his dice head and bow tie. The coloring sheet balances large suit and trouser shapes with buttons, glove lines, and furniture details.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Reacting as an Excited Cuphead Hugs His Leg on the Game Show Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice reacting as an excited Cuphead hugs his leg on the game show stage, raising both gloves in surprise. Cuphead smiles up at him in front of the hanging curtains. Their faces, bow tie, striped straw, and coat tails provide smaller details within the large character shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Trying to Reclaim His Microphone While Cuphead Talks to the Radio Audience Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice reaching to reclaim his microphone while Cuphead addresses the radio audience, beside a small radio on a stool. Cuphead extends his free arm as King Dice leans forward with one hand on his hip. The microphone grille, striped straw, radio controls, and curtain folds add smaller areas to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Recognizing Cuphead on the Devil's Wanted Poster Backstage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice recognizing Cuphead on the Devil's wanted poster backstage, pointing at the portrait while holding up its ragged paper. His widened eyes and open mouth emphasize the reaction beside a tied theater curtain. The coloring sheet also includes a wooden crate, coiled rope, floorboards, and broad tuxedo panels.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Calling the Devil on the Backstage Telephone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice calling the Devil on a backstage telephone, holding the receiver beside his dice head and gesturing with his free glove. The telephone rests on a wooden crate beneath a long curled cord. Hanging ropes, tied curtains, and the phone's fork-shaped cradle add narrow details around his tuxedo on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Cueing the Band While Cuphead Tries to Name the Tune Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice cueing the band while Cuphead tries to name the tune, with a raised glove and music notes nearby. Playing card musicians perform on trumpet and drum while Cuphead touches his chin beside a microphone. The coloring sheet includes card suit symbols, drum patterns, curtain folds, and large areas across King Dice's suit.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice and Cuphead Waiting for a Stage Frightened Mugman to Answer the Helpline Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice and Cuphead waiting for a stage-frightened Mugman to answer the helpline, with Mugman clutching the telephone receiver. Sweat drops and trembling lines surround Mugman's worried face as the others lean near him. The coloring sheet includes a coiled telephone cord, a chair, a tabletop, and bold character outlines.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Presenting the Giant Dice Mechanism While Cuphead Prepares to Roll Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice presenting a giant dice mechanism while Cuphead prepares to roll, gripping the lever beside its tall decorated base. The oversized die sits between two curved supports above Cuphead's striped straw. Broad dice faces and stage curtains give this coloring sheet open sections, with smaller pips, buttons, and floorboard lines.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Staring at the Broken Dice Mechanism and Its Scattered Pieces Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice staring at a broken dice mechanism, holding a glove to his cheek beside its exposed gears and shattered casing. Loose cogwheels, an axle, and fragments lie across the stage floor. The coloring sheet contrasts his broad tuxedo shapes with closely spaced mechanical details and cracked dice panels.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Facing the Angry Audience After His Game Show Is Exposed as Rigged Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice facing an angry audience after his rigged game show is exposed, raising both palms beside a shattered dice machine. Three spectators point toward him from their seats while gears and broken panels remain visible onstage. The coloring sheet includes expressive faces, broad coat panels, curtains, and scattered mechanical debris.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Being Knocked Off His Feet By Elder Kettle's Runaway Tire Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice knocked off his feet by Elder Kettle's runaway tire, with playing cards and small dice flying around him. His gloves and legs spread above the rolling wheel as dust and movement lines trail behind. The coloring sheet emphasizes the tire's chunky tread, the airborne tuxedo, and the scattered card suit details.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Refusing Henchman's Autograph Request in the Elevator Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice refusing Henchman's autograph request in an elevator, holding up a flat palm while Henchman offers a notebook and pencil. King Dice frowns with his other hand on his hip beside the small demon's drooping face. The coloring sheet includes elevator buttons, paneled walls, handrails, and broad clothing shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Being Demoted By the Devil in Inkwell Hell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice being demoted by the Devil in Inkwell Hell, shrinking back with raised gloves beneath the Devil's pointing finger. Sweat drops surround his dice head as flames and jagged cave shapes frame the pair. Fur edges, horns, small dice spots, and large tuxedo areas create varied sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Eating a Cooked Shoe Beside His Mattress in the Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice eating a cooked shoe beside his alley mattress, lifting a strip on a fork above the steaming plated boot. He sits on a wooden crate near a brick wall and drainpipe. The coloring sheet adds shoelaces, a patched mattress, a blanket, and a trash can around his large tuxedo shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Meeting Cuphead and Mugman with Mugman's Ventriloquist Dummy in the Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice meeting Cuphead and Mugman in an alley, with Mugman holding his ventriloquist dummy as Cuphead raises a glove. King Dice looks down at them with both palms lifted beside the brick wall. The dummy's jointed limbs, a drainpipe, mattress, crate, and trash can provide additional details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Getting Cleaned Up and Fitted with Fresh Clothes at Elder Kettle's Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice getting fitted with fresh clothes at Elder Kettle's cottage, standing on a step stool beside a measuring tape. Elder Kettle holds the tape near a sewing basket filled with fabric, scissors, and yarn. The coloring sheet includes a fireplace, curtained window, shelves, and broad sections across King Dice's new suit.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Arriving with Cuphead at the Old Barn Converted Into a Club Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice arriving with Cuphead at an old barn converted into a club, walking beside a winding path toward open doors. King Dice gestures toward the building's awning, light strings, stars, and musical notes. Fence posts, trees, clouds, and the large blank marquee add clearly outlined shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Producing Magical Playing Cards That Become His Backing Band Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice producing magical playing cards that become his backing band, with swirling trails and music notes rising above his gloves. Card musicians hold a saxophone, trumpet, drums, and upright string instruments around him. The coloring sheet offers many small instrument and card suit details alongside his larger tuxedo and shoe shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Performing with His Playing Card Band for the Barn Club Audience Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice performing with his playing card band for the barn club audience, singing at a microphone beneath hanging lanterns. The musicians play drums, trumpet, and an upright string instrument behind him. Wooden beams and floorboards frame the stage, while audience heads and raised hands fill the foreground of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Washing Up Backstage at the Barn Club as the Devil Waits Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice washing up backstage at the barn club, rubbing his gloves beneath a faucet as the Devil waits in the doorway. Soap bubbles gather over the sink beside a hanging towel and exposed drainpipe. The Devil's crossed arms, curved tail, and horns add distinct details to the wooden backstage setting on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Bargaining with the Devil Backstage Beside the Devil's Pitchfork Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice bargaining with the Devil backstage, raising an open glove beside the Devil's tall three-pronged pitchfork and pointed tail. Both characters smile near a tied curtain, wooden crate, and barrel. The coloring sheet combines King Dice's broad suit panels with the Devil's fur edges, curved horns, and smaller facial details.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Bringing a Rolled Management Contract to Cuphead's Table at the Club Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice bringing a rolled management contract to Cuphead's club table, offering the scroll while Cuphead looks up from his seat. King Dice keeps his free hand behind his back beside the round table's draped cloth. Long tuxedo panels, curtain folds, floorboards, and the paper's curled ends shape this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Watching Cuphead Tear Up the Management Contract Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice watching Cuphead tear up the management contract, with both characters baring their teeth as paper scraps scatter around them. Cuphead grips the document's two sides, splitting its written lines and ribboned seal. The coloring sheet focuses on their large faces, gloves, the jagged tear, and small flying fragments.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Leaving the Barn as Mugman Entertains the Audience with His Ventriloquist Dummy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice leaving the barn while Mugman entertains the audience with his ventriloquist dummy, seated onstage beneath hanging string lights. King Dice walks through the open doors with a downturned mouth as two spectators watch the performance. Broad coat and door shapes surround the smaller stage details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Joining the Devil and Henchman in the Elevator Outside the Barn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice joining the Devil and Henchman in the elevator outside the barn, standing beside the open doorway beneath a ceiling lamp. King Dice extends one glove while the Devil folds his arms and Henchman rests his hands on his hips. Dice spots, horns, tail curves, elevator buttons, and wooden panels detail the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Entering the Devil's Cavern and Discovering Piles of Demon Ashes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice entering the Devil's cavern and discovering piles of demon ashes, looking down with one glove near his mouth. Three small heaps lie across the rocky foreground, including one with a protruding horn. Stalactites and pointed cave formations surround the broad suit and trouser areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Being Ordered to Join the Devil's Demons on Their Mission Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice being ordered to join the Devil's demons on their mission, pointing at himself as the Devil indicates a cave passage. Two small demons walk away beneath the jagged tunnel arch while the Devil holds his trident. The coloring sheet includes broad tuxedo panels, curved horns and tails, and small rocky ground details.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Persuading Two Demons to Turn Against a Rival in the Hay Maze Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice persuading two demons to turn against a rival in the hay maze, pointing toward a horned creature down the passage. The two nearby demons grin beside him with their long segmented tails curved upward. Straw edges and bale ties provide repeated fine details around the larger character shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Confronting the Last Sneezing Demon Between the Hay Maze Walls Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice confronting the last sneezing demon between hay maze walls, leaning toward the small horned figure as it holds a handkerchief. The demon's squeezed-shut eyes, droplets, wings, and curved pointed tail make the action clear. Stacked bales and scattered straw marks frame the pair on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Hiding at the Hay Maze Exit with a Net Ready to Catch Cuphead Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice hiding at the hay maze exit with a net, gripping its long handle as Cuphead approaches along the passage. His smiling face peeks around the corner of a tall bale wall. The net's mesh creates many small sections, while the suit panels, hay bales, and open sky offer larger areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Frozen in Fright with His Net as the Four Horsemen Appear at the Hay Maze Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice frozen in fright with his net as the Four Horsemen appear, riding through the hay maze behind him. Four skeletal riders have flame outlines around their skulls and capes draped over their shoulders. The coloring sheet combines King Dice's large startled face with smaller reins, bones, net mesh, and straw details.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Emerging from Flames with His Playing Card Assistants at the Dance Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice emerging from flames with playing card assistants at the dance arena, extending one glove while stepping across the round floor. Two bow-tied assistants display heart and club symbols beneath the flame outlines. The coloring sheet includes large tuxedo panels, curved stage borders, columns, and smaller dice spots and card details.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Introducing the Devil and Ms. Chalice for Their Dance Contest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice introducing the Devil and Ms. Chalice for their dance contest, holding a microphone and gesturing between the contestants. The Devil carries his pitchfork while Ms. Chalice poses in a flared dress and heeled shoes. Curtain folds, dice spots, horns, and the dress's wavy hem add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice Presenting the Applaud-o-meter to the Dance Contest Audience Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice presenting the Applaud-o-meter to the dance contest audience, gesturing toward a large semicircular gauge with a pointed needle. Spectators clap beneath the stage while King Dice smiles beside the ornate stand. The coloring sheet includes broad gauge and suit areas, tick marks, curled trim, curtain folds, and small audience features.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice in Root Pack Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice in the Root Pack garden, standing with his hands on his hips before rows of leafy vegetable plants. An onion, carrot, and tearful potato peer above the garden beds behind his dice head. The coloring sheet pairs broad suit and soil shapes with leaves, dice spots, and the vegetables' distinct facial features.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice in Devil Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice seated in the Devil's throne room, smiling beneath a skull ornament with his gloves resting on the armrests. Tall pointed windows and a few outlined bricks surround the high-backed chair. His large bow tie, dice spots, suit lapels, and spacious trouser sections form the main areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice in Esther Winchester Desert Town Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows King Dice in Esther Winchester's desert town, raising both gloves beneath a tall hat with dice decorations around its band. Wooden storefronts, cacti, tumbleweeds, and a water tower line the street behind him. Broad clothing shapes contrast with small windows, planks, distant mesas, and sparse ground details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice in Djimmi Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features King Dice in Djimmi's desert, smiling with his hands on his hips before dunes, palm trees, and a pyramid building. His oversized bow tie and checked waistcoat stand out beneath the square dice head. The coloring sheet includes a crescent moon, light cloud outlines, small architectural details, and broad open areas in his jacket.

pages.title: Cuphead King Dice in Baroness Von Bon Bon Candy Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts King Dice in Baroness Von Bon Bon's candy kingdom, wearing a tall top hat and gripping his tuxedo lapels with both gloves. Lollipops, a striped candy cane, and a turreted castle rise behind his smiling dice face. The coloring sheet mixes large hat and jacket spaces with candy spirals, stripes, and small costume details.
